title: cistus × revolii nothosubsp. grandiflorus
intro: Cistus × revolii nothosubsp. grandiflorus, commonly known as the Large-flowered Cistus, is a hybrid plant species within the Cistus genus, known for its large, showy flowers and drought tolerance. The health benefits of Cistus × revolii nothosubsp. grandiflorus include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may aid in wound healing and skin protection. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce stress, and exhibit antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Cistus × revolii nothosubsp. grandiflorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
